items.headline: Marcus Stokes has 5 total TDs after halftime, Memphis rallies to beat ECU 34-31 in OT
items.description: — Marcus Stokes was 29-of-43 passing for 320 yards and three touchdowns and added two rushing TDs to help Memphis beat East Carolina 41-34 in overtime on Thursday night.

items.headline: TJ Smith has pick-6 as Tulane forces 6 turnovers in 31-17 victory over Memphis
items.description: — TJ Smith returned an interception 76 yards for a touchdown on the final play of the first half, and Johnnie Daniels raced 48 yards for a score on a fourth-and-1 run with 1:34 remaining as Tulane forced six turnovers in a 31-17 victory over Memphis...
